        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes (moderate with cadence changes every 3 minutes)
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lying_leg_raise 2x10
    WEEK 2:

          walking 5 minutes

          lat_stretch 60 seconds

        cardio:

        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_rotation 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation: stability emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes with 3x20s sprint efforts every 4 minutes
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Low-impact cardio session with zones":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main:
          cycling 10 minutes zone 2
          cycling 8 minutes zone 3 intervals: 30s high resistance/90s recover
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds

        cooldown:

    WEEK 6:
